memberdef.argsstring: (const APInt &A, const APInt &B, function_ref< APInt(const APInt &, const APInt &, bool &Overflow)> Op)
memberdef.name: runOpWithExpandOnOverflow

param.type: function_ref< APInt(const APInt &, const APInt &, bool &Overflow)>

briefdescription.para: Bring a and b to have the same width and then call op(a, b, overflow).

sect2.title: Arithmetic operators.
sect2.para: If the overflow bit becomes set, resize a and b to double the width and call op(a, b, overflow), returning its result. The operation with double widths should not also overflow.
